dossolesShip.name: 多索雷斯
dossolesShip.desc:
根据在场的【多索雷斯】干员数量，触发效果。
<在场2名不同【多索雷斯】干员>【多索雷斯】干员的攻击范围视为特殊水地形，处于特殊水地形中时，攻击附带相当于攻击力10%的侵蚀损伤（可叠加，每层增加0.1%）。
敌人处于特殊水地形中时，移动与攻击速度降低10%（可叠加，每层增加0.5%，至多80%）。
<在场4名不同【多索雷斯】干员>敌人受到侵蚀损伤爆发时，防御力额外降低50点（可叠加，每层增加2）。
敌人处于损伤爆发期间时，每0.5秒受到1次基于场上攻击力最高的【多索雷斯】干员50%攻击力的元素伤害（可叠加，每层增加1%）。

tiers.effect: Every 【多索雷斯】 operator's attack range counts as 特殊水地形. A 【多索雷斯】 operator standing on it (its own range includes its own tile) carries 侵蚀损伤 on its attacks: 10% + 0.1%·L of its ATK, as an `erosion` element rider. An enemy standing on it has its move speed and attack speed reduced by min(80%, 10% + 0.5%·L).

An enemy whose 侵蚀损伤 bursts takes an extra −(50 + 2·L) flat DEF on top of the engine's own 侵蚀 burst (−120); while it is in a burst cooldown, it takes one 元素伤害 every 0.5 s equal to (50% + 1%·L) of the ATK of the highest-ATK 【多索雷斯】 operator on the field.

formulas.burstDefDown: defFlat −(50 + 2·L), stacking per burst like the engine's own erosion (−120)
formulas.burstPulse: max(atk of 【多索雷斯】 on field) × (0.50 + 0.01·L) every 0.5 s

spec.caps: one erosion rider per damaging hit (any damage the member deals to an enemy, matching the engine's 灼燃损伤 rider on 「炎佑」); the 移动/攻击速度 reduction of the first tier is capped at 80% (`bb.water_slow_cap`, printed by the card as the `至多{2:0%}` of the 当前效果 line)
spec.layerGain: The story-bond axis: layers come from the same 盟约叠层 sources every other bond uses.
spec.howToPlay: Field 【多索雷斯】 operators and keep them inside each other's attack ranges — the union of their ranges is the 「特殊水地形」 (painted on the board as a light-blue pulsing tile overlay), so they erode anything they hit and slow whatever stands in it.
assumed: 「攻击范围视为特殊水地形」 is read as a virtual tile set (the union of the members' attack-range tiles) — the engine has no per-tile custom terrain state, and this reading makes 「处于特殊水地形中」 decidable without one
「攻击附带…侵蚀损伤」 follows the engine's own rider precedent (炎's 炎佑): any damaging hit by the member on an enemy carries the erosion element, not only a basic attack
「攻击速度降低 x%」 is mapped to the engine's additive 攻速 mod (aspd: −x×100 points), the only attack-speed axis the engine exposes for enemies; 移动速度 uses moveMul
「每层」 is the bond's 层数 (bondLayers, the 盟约叠层 axis), not the member count; the two member counts are the tiers (2 / 4)
the 80% 上限 of 「移动与攻击速度降低 x%」 is an [ASSUMED] cap: the text says 「至多80%」, and the pair (moveMul, aspd points) is clamped to it together

which tiles the 「特殊水地形」 covers is shown to the player with `battle.fx('dosWater', { tiles })` (a light-blue pulsing tile overlay, `public/js/render/fx/kinds.js`) — a display-only event, no gameplay state
「损伤爆发期间」 is the erosion burst cooldown (the engine's `<el>Burst` lock); the 2nd-tier pulse needs a 【多索雷斯】 operator on the field to read an ATK from
